hook.name: FlashPerpsHook
hook.description: A custom-curve (NoOp) perpetuals hook where each registered PERP/USDG pool is a single-venue market; swaps mint new perp exposure (buy) or unwind existing positions (sell) through registered vaults, charging a flat 0.3% USDG fee routed to a buyback escrow. No passive liquidity providers exist; `beforeAddLiquidity` always reverts.
